Business uses submitted non-return invoice final payable, including partly paid bills, converted to net sales. Collections use the Billing collections report. Sales and collections are ex-GST (inclusive amount ÷ 1.05). Dues remain actual payable balances. Collectable balances follow invoice due dates; undated balances remain in Overall. Race ranks Billing report collections in the selected period. Employee attribution uses submitted Payment Entry allocations, split 50/50 where shared; Hi Ticket uses collected money on one invoice, with joint owners shown together. Attendance P uses punch records or recorded attendance; A is provisional until the day closes. Leave and weekly off are excluded. Unavailable sources show —.
